metadata.name: rea
metadata.description: Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.

summary.zh: REA 是基于 AI 智能体的逆向工程引擎，能无需源码深度解析原生二进制、Electron 应用及网页。它集成 Hopper、Ghidra 等工具，自动收集行为证据，还原核心逻辑，助力快速复刻与学习应用底层实现。
summary.en: REA is an AI-agent-driven reverse engineering platform that enables deep analysis of native binaries, applications, and runtime behaviors without requiring source code. By bridging AI agents with tools like Hopper, Ghidra, and browser inspectors, it extracts core logic, provides concrete evidence, and helps developers replicate complex features in their own projects.

metadata.name: go-music-dl
metadata.description: 一个基于 Go 语言的全网音乐搜索与下载工具。支持 CLI 命令行与 Web 服务双模式，内置网易云、QQ、酷狗、Bilibili、汽水音乐等 10+ 个主流平台，支持多源并发搜索与无损音质解析。music-dl交流群：755087923

summary.zh: 基于Go语言的全网音乐搜索下载工具，支持CLI、Web和桌面三种模式，内置10+主流平台，实现多源并发搜索与无损解析。提供歌单解析、本地管理、扫码登录等功能，适用于音乐爱好者批量下载与管理。
summary.en: A Go-based music search and download tool that supports CLI, web, and desktop application modes. It features built-in integration with over 10 mainstream music platforms, enabling multi-source concurrent search and lossless audio quality parsing. The tool also offers playlist and album parsing, local music management, and scan-to-login functionality, making it ideal for music enthusiasts to efficiently batch download and manage their collections.

metadata.name: DroidExtend
metadata.description: 用一根 USB 数据线把安卓手机/平板变成 Windows 的第二块显示器——是真扩展桌面而不是投屏镜像。端到端延迟实测 5–11 ms，支持触摸反控，拔线即摘屏。全部源代码由 AI 编写。

summary.zh: DroidExtend 是一款将安卓手机变为 Windows 扩展显示器的工具，通过 USB 数据线实现真扩展桌面而非镜像投屏，端到端延迟仅 5–11ms，支持触摸反控和拔线即停，基于硬件编码解码和虚拟显示驱动技术，适用于多屏办公和移动扩展场景。
summary.en: DroidExtend turns an Android phone into a secondary Windows monitor via USB, offering true desktop extension (not screen mirroring) with 5–11ms latency, touch back control, and instant unplugging. It uses hardware-accelerated encoding/decoding and a virtual display driver, ideal for multi-screen productivity.

metadata.name: duanjuzhijia-down-tv
metadata.description: 短剧之家 v2（红果）TV 版｜电视盒子 / 智能电视红果短剧播放器，免费下载。遥控器操作，支持搜索、收藏、选集，可与手机、电脑同步观看进度。

summary.zh: 短剧之家TV版专为安卓电视盒子打造，集成红果短剧资源，支持遥控器操作、搜索收藏、倍速连播及跨设备进度同步，轻量级设计确保低配置设备流畅运行，是家庭大屏免费追剧的理想选择。
summary.en: Short Drama Home TV is crafted for Android TV boxes, integrating Hongguo's short drama content with remote control, search, favorites, speed adjustment, auto-play, and cross-device progress sync. Its lightweight design ensures smooth performance on low-spec devices, making it an ideal free choice for family TV watching.

metadata.name: HeinPlay
metadata.description: 海因影视，用于lunatv（moontv）的Android TV客户端，以及手机、Windows等多平台客户端，本地缓存比网页版更流畅的访问速度

summary.zh: 基于 Flutter 的跨平台影视客户端，全面支持 Android TV、手机、Windows、Linux（适配 Steam Deck）及 HarmonyOS。深度集成 LunaTV，通过本地缓存与多播放器后端（ExoPlayer/fvp）优化，提供流畅的直播回放、点播及多端无缝同步体验。
summary.en: A cross-platform video client based on Flutter, supporting Android TV, mobile, Windows, Linux (optimized for Steam Deck), and HarmonyOS. It deeply integrates LunaTV, utilizing local caching and multi-player backends (ExoPlayer/fvp) to deliver smooth live catchup, VOD playback, and seamless multi-device synchronization.

metadata.name: EcoHub
metadata.description: 一款高性能、现代化支持的全栈多源影视采集聚合系统，用于搭建自己的私人影视库，支持Tvbox与Ecohub原生应用

summary.zh: EcoHub 是一款高性能全栈多源影视采集聚合系统，基于 Go 与 Next.js，支持自动化多源采集与 TVBox、鸿蒙等跨平台客户端，助您快速搭建专属私人影视库。
summary.en: EcoHub is a high-performance full-stack video aggregation system supporting multi-source automated collection. Built with Go and Next.js, it provides cross-platform clients to help you easily build your private movie library.

metadata.name: Navo
metadata.description: Independent, unofficial Telegram client for Android, Windows, and macOS. Sign in with your existing Telegram account — built with Flutter on TDLib.

summary.zh: Navo是一款基于Flutter和TDLib技术构建的跨平台、非官方Telegram客户端。支持Android、iOS、Windows及macOS多端同步登录，为用户提供独立、安全且功能丰富的即时通讯体验，完美复刻官方核心功能。
summary.en: Navo is an independent, unofficial Telegram client designed for maximum cross-platform flexibility. Built with Flutter and powered by TDLib, it supports Android, iOS, Windows, and macOS, allowing users to seamlessly sign in with their existing accounts. It delivers a robust, native messaging experience while remaining completely independent of the official Telegram infrastructure.

metadata.name: czkawka
metadata.description: Multi functional app to find duplicates, empty folders, similar images etc.

summary.zh: 基于Rust的多平台文件清理工具，核心价值在于高效、安全地查找重复文件、空文件夹、相似图片及损坏文件。支持多线程与缓存加速，提供GUI、CLI及Android多端前端，适用于个人存储整理与系统维护。
summary.en: A powerful, memory-safe Rust utility for finding duplicates, empty folders, and similar media across multiple platforms. Boasting high performance through multithreading and caching, it offers versatile GUI, CLI, and Android frontends to securely and efficiently clean up storage.

metadata.name: LetRecovery
metadata.description: 一款免费开源的 Windows 系统重装工具

summary.zh: LetRecovery 是一款基于 Rust 的免费开源 Windows 系统重装工具。支持多格式镜像与 WinPE 双端部署，集成 BitLocker 解密、系统优化及工具箱，适用于系统维护与高效部署。
summary.en: LetRecovery is a free and open-source Windows system recovery and backup tool, built with Rust. It supports multi-format image deployment, WinPE dual-end operation, BitLocker decryption, and comprehensive system optimization features, making it ideal for system maintenance, troubleshooting, and efficient OS deployment. It provides a rich toolkit for PC experts.

metadata.name: clash-verge-rev
metadata.description: A modern GUI client based on Tauri, designed to run in Windows, macOS and Linux for tailored proxy experience

summary.zh: 基于Tauri与Rust构建的跨平台Clash Meta GUI客户端，内置mihomo核心。提供可视化节点规则编辑、配置文件增强、TUN模式及高度自定义主题，旨在为用户带来优雅高效的代理体验。
summary.en: A modern, cross-platform Clash Meta GUI client built on Tauri 2 and Rust. It integrates the mihomo proxy engine, offering visual rule editing, profile management, TUN mode, and deep UI customization. Designed for Windows, macOS, and Linux, it provides a sleek, powerful, and highly efficient local proxy experience.

metadata.name: zhangxuefeng-skill
metadata.description: 张雪峰.skill — 张雪峰的认知操作系统。高考志愿/考研/职业规划的实战思维框架。由女娲.skill生成。

summary.zh: 张雪峰.skill是一个模拟教育规划师张雪峰思维的认知操作系统，基于大量著作和采访提炼核心心智模型与决策启发式。适用于高考志愿、考研及职业规划场景，为AI智能体提供实战思维框架，帮助用户做出更理性的教育选择。技术上采用提示工程方法，可跨多运行时部署。
summary.en: Zhangxuefeng.skill is a cognitive operating system that simulates the thinking of education planner Zhang Xuefeng, distilled from numerous books and interviews into core mental models and decision heuristics. It applies to college entrance exam, graduate school, and career planning, providing AI agents with a practical thinking framework for rational educational choices. Built with prompt engineering, it supports multiple runtimes.

metadata.name: edgeever
metadata.description: AI-native knowledge base & Evernote/Obsidian alternative with instant sync & native MCP. Free on Cloudflare or self-hosted via Docker.

summary.zh: EdgeEver 是一款 AI 原生开源知识库，复刻经典三栏布局，支持原生 MCP 与即时同步。提供免费云端与 Docker 自托管双模式，融合 AI 智能体，重塑高效、私有的数据管理体验。
summary.en: EdgeEver is an AI-native, open-source knowledge base and a modern alternative to Evernote and Obsidian, designed to deliver complete data ownership and smart productivity. It revives the classic three-pane layout while offering native MCP integration for seamless AI agent interactions and instant synchronization. Optimized for lightweight capture and heavy knowledge management, it provides a dual deployment strategy: completely free serverless hosting on Cloudflare or flexible self-hosting via Docker on VPS or NAS, catering to both casual notes and complex private AI workflows.

metadata.name: Open-Box
metadata.description: Open-Box 一体化透明代理：OpenWrt / Debian / Ubuntu / Docker；自有程序闭源，第三方组件遵守原许可。

summary.zh: Open-Box 是一款一体化透明代理解决方案，支持路由器端与多平台客户端协同。内置 sing-box 内核与可视化 Web 面板，无需手写配置文件，即可实现一键订阅分流、链式代理与真实路由测试，极大简化网络管理。
summary.en: Open-Box is an integrated transparent proxy solution supporting router and multi-platform client synergy. Featuring a built-in sing-box kernel and visual web panel, it enables one-click subscription routing, chain proxy, and real route testing without manual configuration files.

metadata.name: stremio-web
metadata.description: Stremio - Freedom to Stream

summary.zh: Stremio Web是官方跨平台媒体中心网页应用，基于React与Rust WASM内核，支持插件扩展、多端同步、Chromecast投屏与PWA安装，提供流畅的个性化流媒体播放体验。
summary.en: Stremio Web is the official cross-platform media center UI, delivering a seamless streaming experience in the browser. Powered by React and a Rust WebAssembly core, it supports addon catalogs, library sync, Chromecast casting, and PWA installation.

metadata.name: lx-lxwalnut-music-mobile
metadata.description: 基于lx-netease-music-mobile改版，满足个人需求，仅个人自用！！！

summary.zh: 本项目是一个基于React Native的个性化音乐播放器，源自lx-netease-music-mobile，支持网易云、QQ、酷狗等多平台音源聚合，提供自定义音源插件、主题定制、本地音乐管理及小爱音箱推送等功能，适合追求高度自定义与多平台整合的音乐爱好者。
summary.en: This is a personalized music player built with React Native, based on lx-netease-music-mobile. It aggregates multiple music platforms like NetEase, QQ, and Kugou, offering custom audio source plugins, theme customization, local music management, and Xiao Ai speaker integration, catering to music enthusiasts who seek high customization and multi-platform integration.

metadata.name: x-ui-pro
metadata.description: XUI-PRO nginx reverse proxy with ws/grpc/httpupgrade/splithttp,xray protocol support: vless,vmess,trojan,shadowsocks panel cloudflare ssl,xtls,ssr,v2fly,v2ray installer bypass restrictions sing-box,shadowtls,reality,tunnel,gfw tor warp wireguard geoip tuic clash vpn mihomo psiphon hy2 oneclick argo bbr wstunnel anticensorship⚡🛡️

summary.zh: x-ui-pro 是集成 Nginx 反向代理的多协议代理面板部署工具，支持 Xray、Tor 及 WARP。通过流量伪装、自动 SSL，为多用户提供低检测、高安全的科学上网与网络突破管理方案。
summary.en: x-ui-pro is a multi-protocol proxy panel deployment tool integrated with Nginx reverse proxy, supporting Xray, Tor, and WARP. It provides auto SSL, traffic camouflage, and multi-user management for secure, low-detection censorship circumvention.

metadata.name: ai-coding-welfare
metadata.description: AI Coding 福利站导航：免费白嫖 Claude Code / Codex 的中转站与公益站合集，含额度、模型、价格自动更新与一键配置脚本

summary.zh: 本仓库是一个 AI 编码福利站导航，收录多个提供免费 Claude Code、Codex 等工具的中转站与公益站。通过自动更新的额度与价格数据、一键配置脚本及多语言支持，助力开发者高效获取免费 AI 编码资源，降低使用成本。
summary.en: This repository is a comprehensive navigation hub for AI coding welfare stations, collecting multiple relay and public welfare sites that offer free credits for popular AI coding tools like Claude Code and Codex. It provides automatic data updates on credits, models, and prices, along with one-click configuration scripts and multi-language support. The platform also includes status monitoring and change logs, enabling developers to efficiently acquire free AI coding resources and significantly lower their usage costs.

metadata.name: MyIP
metadata.description: The best IP Toolbox. Check your IP address & geolocation, test IP for WebRTC and DNS IP leaks, run an IP quality check, browser fingerprint check, website availability check, network speed test, global latency test, MTR test, Whois search, and more.

summary.zh: MyIP 是一款开源、全能的 IP 工具箱，支持 Docker 一键自建。集成 IP 查询、WebRTC 与 DNS 泄露检测、网络测速、浏览器指纹等核心功能，全方位助力用户快速诊断网络、保护个人隐私与评估安全状态。
summary.en: MyIP is an open-source, all-in-one IP toolbox that can be easily self-hosted with a single Docker command. Integrating IP geolocation, WebRTC and DNS leak detection, network speed tests, browser fingerprinting, and a security checklist, it provides a comprehensive suite for diagnosing network issues, protecting personal privacy, and assessing overall cybersecurity posture.

metadata.name: lx-music-xinghai-source
metadata.description: 星海音乐源 | LX Music 自定义音源插件，聚合 GDAPI/ChKSz API，支持酷我加密音频解密（需自行配置）

summary.zh: 星海音乐源是 LX Music 自定义音源插件，聚合 GDAPI、ChKSz API，集成五大平台高清音源。核心亮点是支持酷我加密音频 `.mflac`/`.mgg` 实时代理解密，显著提升桌面端音乐覆盖与播放体验。
summary.en: The Xinghai Music Source is a custom plugin for LX Music that aggregates tracks from five major platforms. Its core highlight is supporting real-time proxy decryption of Kuwo encrypted audio formats, expanding high-quality availability and enhancing the desktop playback experience.

metadata.name: gitpush
metadata.description: an AI Github Rlease Tracker Powered by Cloudflare

summary.zh: GitPush 是一款基于 Cloudflare 的 AI 驱动 GitHub 发布追踪工具，自动监控用户指定的仓库，利用 Workers AI 生成智能摘要，通过邮件通知用户。它采用无服务器架构，支持定时和手动触发，无需部署，开箱即用，适合开发者高效追踪项目更新。
summary.en: GitPush is an AI-powered GitHub release tracker built on Cloudflare. It automatically monitors specified repositories, generates AI summaries using Workers AI, and delivers updates via email. With serverless architecture, it supports scheduled and manual triggers, offering a no-deploy cloud version for developers to efficiently track project updates.

metadata.name: lx-music-server
metadata.description: 运行在 Hono.js 上的 LX Music 数据同步服务，支持Cloudflare Worker部署

summary.zh: lx-music-server 基于 Cloudflare Workers 和 Durable Objects，提供无服务器音乐数据同步方案，无需自托管即可实现多设备实时同步。通过 Hono.js 和 WebSocket 支持歌单与偏好设置的增量同步与冲突处理，利用 KV 存储实现用户隔离。适用于 LX Music 客户端跨设备同步，具有部署简单、扩展性强的特点。
summary.en: lx-music-server is a serverless music data sync service built on Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects, enabling multi-device real-time synchronization without self-hosting. It uses Hono.js and WebSocket for incremental sync and conflict resolution of playlists and preferences, with KV storage for user isolation. Ideal for cross-device sync in LX Music client, it features easy deployment and high scalability.

metadata.name: Median
metadata.description: 一个功能密度极高的，安装包仅200kb的极致轻量化浏览器

summary.zh: 基于 Android WebView 的极致轻量（仅200kb）隐私浏览器，采用原生 Java 开发。集成广告拦截、本地密码库、用户脚本及离线阅读，零遥测，确保数据本地化安全。
summary.en: An ultra-lightweight (200kb) privacy browser for Android, built on System WebView with native Java. Integrates ad blocking, local password vault, user scripts, and offline reading with zero telemetry for local-first data security.

metadata.name: openwrt-clashoo
metadata.description: 基于 mihomo 和 sing-box 的简单、稳定、开箱即用的 LuCI 代理应用

summary.zh: Clashoo 是一款面向 OpenWrt 的 LuCI 代理插件，集成 mihomo 和 sing-box 双内核，提供简单、稳定、开箱即用的代理管理体验。它具备实时状态监控、智能配置生成、灵活 DNS 策略和透明代理功能，支持一键订阅拉取、内核切换和组件更新，适合需要高效网络代理的用户。
summary.en: Clashoo is a LuCI proxy plugin for OpenWrt that integrates both mihomo and sing-box kernels, offering a simple, stable, and ready-to-use proxy management solution. It features real-time status monitoring, intelligent configuration generation, flexible DNS policies, and transparent proxy support. With one-click subscription fetching, kernel switching, and component updates, it's ideal for users needing efficient network proxying.

metadata.name: fapiao-print
metadata.description: 发票酱 - 发票批量打印工具，轻量桌面应用+WEB模式，支持 PDF、OFD、XML、图片等多格式，一键识别发票数据，快速排版、打印、重命名或导出

summary.zh: 发票酱是一款轻量级桌面发票批量打印工具，支持PDF、OFD、XML及图片多格式。集成原生OFD解析与智能OCR识别，提供灵活排版、智能去重与批量重命名，大幅提升财务发票处理效率。
summary.en: Fapiao-print is a lightweight desktop application designed for batch printing electronic invoices, supporting PDF, OFD, XML, and images. It offers native OFD rendering, smart OCR recognition, flexible drag-and-drop layout controls, and comprehensive management features like duplicate detection and batch renaming, significantly streamlining financial invoice processing workflows.

metadata.name: LinkSwift
metadata.description: 一个基于 JavaScript 的网盘文件下载地址获取工具。基于【网盘直链下载助手】修改 ，支持 百度网盘 / 阿里云盘 / 中国移动云盘 / 天翼云盘 / 迅雷云盘 / 夸克网盘 / UC网盘 / 123云盘 八大网盘

summary.zh: LinkSwift 是一款基于 JavaScript 的网盘直链获取工具，支持百度网盘、阿里云盘等八大主流网盘。它通过浏览器脚本自动提取文件直接下载地址，方便用户借助外部下载工具突破限速，实现高效下载。项目基于“网盘直链下载助手”修改，安装便捷，是网盘资源下载的实用辅助工具。
summary.en: LinkSwift is a JavaScript-based tool for extracting direct download links from cloud storage services, supporting eight major platforms including Baidu Wangpan and Aliyun Wangpan. It operates as a browser script to automatically retrieve direct file URLs, enabling users to bypass speed limits and achieve high-speed downloads with external download managers. Modified from "Cloud Storage Direct Download Assistant", it is easy to install and serves as a practical assistant for cloud storage file downloads.

metadata.name: hsck
metadata.description: hsck json

summary.zh: 海阔小程序视频数据采集工具，自动生成JSON、TXT及M3U离线格式。支持多分类、缓存去重与微信推送，结合GitHub Actions可实现定时自动化抓取与高效分发。
summary.en: Haiku mini-program offline video data scraper that automatically collects video metadata and generates JSON, TXT, and M3U files. It features multi-category support, media caching, WeChat notifications, and scheduled automation via GitHub Actions, including captcha solving, for robust and efficient data distribution.

metadata.name: otter-music
metadata.description: 基于 React + Capacitor 的免费音乐 App，支持多音源搜索、网易云登录、主流平台歌单导入，以及 B 站音源搜索播放，安装包仅 2.5 MB。基于 GD Studio's Online Music Platform API。

summary.zh: 基于 React 与 Capacitor 构建的轻量级多音源聚合音乐播放器，集成网易云、B站等主流平台搜索、歌单导入与智能音源回退机制，支持 PWA 跨平台部署，安装包仅 2.5 MB，提供极简且丰富的播放体验。
summary.en: A lightweight, multi-source aggregated music player built with React and Capacitor. It integrates NetEase, Bilibili, and other mainstream platforms with smart source fallback, playlist imports, and PWA cross-platform capabilities, delivering a robust music experience in a tiny 2.5 MB package.
tags_zh: 多音源聚合与歌单导入

metadata.name: OmniRoute
metadata.description: Never stop coding. Free MIT AI gateway: one endpoint, 359 providers (150+ free), 1200+ models Kimi, Claude, GPT, Gemini, GLM, DeepSeek, MiniMax. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Cline & Copilot. Quota-aware auto-fallback, RTK+Caveman compression saves 15-95% tokens, MCP/A2A, Desktop/PWA. Built by hundreds of contributors

summary.zh: OmniRoute是免费AI网关，统一接入359个提供商、1200+模型，支持多种AI编码工具。具备配额感知自动回退与令牌压缩功能，可节省大量成本。适用于需要高效访问免费AI模型的场景，提供跨平台、MCP/A2A及桌面/PWA支持。
summary.en: OmniRoute is a free, MIT-licensed AI gateway that provides a single endpoint to access 359 providers and over 1200 models, integrating with tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot. It offers quota-aware auto-fallback and RTK+Caveman compression to save 15-95% tokens, making it ideal for developers seeking cost-effective, unlimited AI access. The solution includes cross-platform support, MCP/A2A, and Desktop/PWA capabilities.

metadata.name: FluxDown
metadata.description: Rust 驱动的多协议下载管理器，支持 HTTP/FTP/BitTorrent 磁力链接及 HLS/DASH 流媒体，智能多线程加速与浏览器无缝集成。精美界面，极致性能，永久免费，零广告。

summary.zh: 基于 Rust 内核的跨平台多协议下载管理器，支持 HTTP、BT 及 HLS/DASH 流媒体。集成智能分片加速、浏览器拦截与 AI 智能体 MCP 管理，本地优先、零广告，提供极致的自动化下载体验。
summary.en: FluxDown is a blazing-fast, Rust-driven multi-protocol download manager supporting HTTP, BitTorrent, and HLS/DASH streaming. It features smart multi-threaded acceleration, seamless browser integration, and built-in MCP support for AI-agent automation. Local-first, free, and open-source with zero ads, it delivers high performance for seamless, automated, and collaborative downloads.

metadata.name: cf-manager

summary.en: This project periodically collects data from video resource websites via GitHub Actions, monitoring their availability in real-time. It generates a visual dashboard and JSON data interfaces without requiring any server. Supporting various source types like libretv and maccms, it is ideal for developers and ops to quickly access online resource site statuses and statistics.

summary.en: sublinkPro is a modern proxy subscription management platform built with Go and React, featuring smart tag classification, professional speed testing, relay chains, real-time traffic monitoring, and Telegram bot management. It supports Docker deployment, ideal for developers and network enthusiasts to efficiently manage proxy nodes.

metadata.name: NetQuality

With flexible testing modes and multi-system support, it serves as an ideal one-stop solution for automated server operations and multi-dimensional network health diagnostics.

Built on Cloudflare Workers, it enables Base58 encoding, multi-source selection, and seamless API forwarding to help users bypass regional blocks and automate streaming source management effortlessly.

metadata.description: MoonTVPlus 是基于 MoonTV v100 二次开发的增强版影视聚合播放器。它在原版基础上新增了外部播放器支持、视频超分、弹幕系统、评论抓取等实用功能，提供更强大的观影体验。

summary.zh: MoonTVPlus是基于MoonTV v100二次开发的增强版影视聚合播放器，支持外部播放器跳转、WebGPU视频超分、弹幕系统及豆瓣评论抓取，集成AI问片与私人影库，提供跨平台、大屏同步的极致观影体验。

It also integrates AI movie search, private library connectivity, and multi-screen synchronization, delivering a premium, highly customizable, and cross-platform streaming experience.

metadata.name: sms_forwarding

summary.en: This project utilizes ESP32C3 and ML307R modules to create an ultra-low-cost hardware SMS forwarder, supporting China Mobile, China Unicom, and China Telecom. With a WEB interface for configuration, it enables multiple push channels (e.g., HTTP, Bark, DingTalk) to forward SMS and maintain phone numbers, ideal for scenarios requiring SMS reception.

metadata.name: videoduplicatefinder
metadata.description: Video Duplicate Finder - Crossplatform

summary.zh: 跨平台视频去重工具，支持不同分辨率、帧率和水印视频相似度匹配。集成音频指纹与AI神经网络嵌入，精准检测局部片段与裁剪副本，提供GUI、CLI及Web部署，适用于多媒体库去重与自动化。
summary.en: Video Duplicate Finder is a highly advanced, cross-platform tool designed to find duplicate video and image files based on robust visual similarity, even when files have different resolutions, frame rates, or watermarks. It features ultra-fast scanning, audio fingerprinting for partial clip detection, and optional AI matching using DINOv2 neural embeddings to identify cropped, mirrored, or heavily edited copies. Offering comprehensive GUI, CLI, Web UI, and Docker deployments, it serves as an ideal, privacy-preserving solution for massive media library deduplication and automated scripting.

跨平台桌面应用与自动化工具

Offers PBKDF2 security, API caching, SEO enhancements, and R2 image management, delivering high-performance, low-latency edge computing solutions for personal and small team blogs.

metadata.name: renewhelper
metadata.description: RenewHelper - 时序·守望是一款基于Cloudflare Workers的全栈服务生命周期提醒、管理工具。它专为管理周期性订阅、域名续费、服务器到期等场景设计。无需服务器，零成本托管，提供精美的机甲风（Mecha-style）UI 界面、强大的农历/公历计算核心、多渠道通知推送能力、iCal日程同步以及账单管理功能。同时支持Worker和Docker方式部署。

summary.zh: RenewHelper是一款基于Cloudflare Workers的全栈服务生命周期管理工具，专为周期性订阅、域名续费等场景设计。无需服务器，零成本托管，提供机甲风UI、农历公历计算、多渠道通知、iCal同步及账单管理功能，支持Worker和Docker部署。
summary.en: RenewHelper is a full-stack service lifecycle management tool based on Cloudflare Workers, designed for periodic subscriptions, domain renewals, etc. Serverless and zero-cost, it offers Mecha-style UI, lunar/solar calendar calculations, multi-channel notifications, iCal sync, and billing management, deployable via Worker or Docker.

metadata.name: go-wxpush
metadata.description: 极简且免费的微信消息推送服务 (基于golang)

summary.zh: go-wxpush 是一个基于 Go 语言的极简微信消息推送服务，通过 HTTP 接口将模板消息推送到指定微信用户。它完全免费，支持 Docker 一键部署，每天提供 10 万次额度，并实现微信原生弹窗和声音提醒。适用于服务告警、自动化通知等场景，具有跨平台、易部署、高额度的技术亮点。
summary.en: Go-wxpush is a minimalist WeChat message push service based on Go, which pushes template messages to specified WeChat users via HTTP interfaces. It is completely free, supports one-click Docker deployment, offers 100,000 daily pushes, and delivers native WeChat pop-up and sound alerts. Suitable for service alerts, automated notifications, and similar scenarios, it features cross-platform deployment, ease of use, and high quota.

metadata.name: dysync.net
metadata.description: 视频同步工具

summary.zh: dysync.net 是一款基于 .NET Core 和 Vue 的跨平台自动化工具，专注于自动同步抖音收藏、喜欢及指定博主视频，并进行信息刮削，无缝接入 Emby/Jellyfin 媒体库，实现多账号视频聚合管理。
summary.en: dysync.net is a .NET Core and Vue-based automation tool that syncs Douyin favorites, likes, and specified creator videos. It features multi-account support, metadata scraping, and seamless integration with Emby/Jellyfin for personal media library management.

metadata.name: argosbx
metadata.description: 小白自建代理神器！ArgoSBX一键无交互小钢炮脚本💣：Sing-box、Xray、Argo三内核自动搭配；支持VPS、Docker、容器多环境部署；套CDN的5大方案+套WARP的15种组合；已支持协议：Naiveproxy、AnyTLS、Any-reality、Vless-xhttp-reality-vision-enc、Vless-tcp-reality-vision、Vless-xhttp-vision-enc、Vless-ws-vision-enc、Shadowsocks-2022、Hysteria2、Tuic、Socks5、Vmess-ws、Argo临时/固定隧道

summary.zh: ArgoSBX是一键无交互自建代理脚本，集成Sing-box、Xray、Argo三内核，支持VPS、Docker等多环境部署。提供CDN的5大方案和WARP的15种组合，覆盖Naiveproxy、AnyTLS等多种协议，助力小白快速搭建稳定代理，解锁流媒体。
summary.en: ArgoSBX is a one-click, non-interactive script for building proxies, integrating Sing-box, Xray, and Argo kernels. It supports deployment on VPS, Docker, and other environments, offering 5 CDN solutions and 15 WARP combinations. With protocols like Naiveproxy and AnyTLS, it enables beginners to quickly set up stable proxies for streaming unlock.

summary.zh: MageKit 是基于 Rust 和 GPUI 的跨平台桌面媒体工具，核心价值在于视频下载、网页媒体捕获与多平台直播录制。它集成 yt-dlp、FFmpeg 与 Streamlink，提供高效的本地化任务与工具管理。
summary.en: A cross-platform desktop media toolkit for video downloading, webpage capture, and live stream recording, built with Rust and GPUI.

summary.zh: 本项目基于LuatOS为Air780E开发板打造智能短信转发系统，支持关键词与正则匹配，可并发转发短信至企业微信、飞书、钉钉等多渠道，附带设备信息与容错机制，适用于物联网场景下的短信通知自动化。
summary.en: This project implements an intelligent SMS forwarding system for the Air780E board based on LuatOS. It supports keyword and regex matching, concurrently forwards SMS to multiple channels like WeCom, Feishu, and DingTalk, includes device info and fault tolerance, and is ideal for automated SMS notifications in IoT scenarios.

metadata.name: uart_sms_forwarder
metadata.description: Air780 短信UART转发器

summary.zh: 基于合宙Air780系列模块的短信UART转发系统，通过串口将短信实时转发至上位机。支持短信收发记录、来电通知，并集成钉钉、企业微信、飞书及自定义Webhook等多种通知方式，适用于IoT场景下的短信自动转发与告警。
summary.en: This project is an SMS UART forwarding system based on Air780 modules, forwarding SMS in real-time to host machines. It features complete SMS record keeping, call notifications, scheduled SMS sending, and multi-channel push notifications via DingTalk, WeCom, Feishu, custom webhooks, and email. It is an ideal solution for IoT SMS gateways and automated alerting systems.

metadata.name: trackerslist
metadata.description: Updated list of public BitTorrent trackers

summary.zh: 本仓库提供持续自动更新的公共BitTorrent Tracker列表，涵盖多种协议及IP直连格式。它能帮助BT客户端快速定位对等节点，显著提升P2P下载效率与稳定性，是网络资源共享的高效辅助工具。
summary.en: This repository provides an automatically updated, comprehensive list of public BitTorrent trackers, supporting multiple protocols and direct IP formats. It helps P2P clients efficiently discover peers, significantly boosting download speed, reliability, and overall resource sharing performance.

summary.zh: cfnew 是基于 Cloudflare Workers 的多协议代理节点管理与订阅生成工具，支持 VLESS、Trojan 等协议，提供图形化 KV 管理、自动测速、多客户端订阅转换及家宽链式路由，助力高效搭建与管理代理服务。
summary.en: cfnew is a powerful multi-protocol proxy management and subscription generation tool deployed on Cloudflare Workers. Supporting VLESS, Trojan, and xhr protocols, it features graphical KV configuration, automatic latency testing, multi-client subscription conversion, residential broadband routing, and ECH support.

metadata.name: free-nodes
metadata.description: 免费节点订阅：Clash、V2RayN、Shadowrocket｜Base64 与 YAML 每 2 小时更新

summary.zh: 本项目聚合公开节点源，每2小时自动更新，提供Base64与Clash YAML两种通用订阅格式，适配Clash、V2RayN、Shadowrocket等主流客户端。通过统一命名与地理标识简化节点管理，降低用户导入门槛，适用于需要稳定免费代理的科学上网场景。
summary.en: This project aggregates public node sources, updates every 2 hours automatically, and provides two universal subscription formats: Base64 and Clash YAML, compatible with mainstream clients like Clash, V2RayN, and Shadowrocket. Unified naming and geographic tags simplify node management, lowering the barrier for users to import subscriptions, suitable for scenarios requiring stable free proxies for scientific internet access.

metadata.name: bilibili-video-downloader
metadata.description: 哔哩哔哩 bilibili B站 视频 下载器，图形界面 + nfo刮削 + 广告标记 + 字幕下载 + 弹幕下载，轻松将视频加入emby等媒体库

summary.zh: 基于Tauri的跨平台哔哩哔哩视频下载器，支持高清画质、字幕弹幕下载及NFO刮削。图形界面简洁易用，可轻松将B站视频归档并导入Emby等媒体库，满足用户离线观看与个性化整理需求。
summary.en: A cross-platform Bilibili video downloader built with Tauri, featuring high-quality video, subtitle, and danmaku downloads, alongside comprehensive metadata scraping and NFO generation. Its clean graphical interface simplifies complex downloads, effortlessly organizing videos into media libraries like Emby for seamless offline playback and management.

metadata.name: whistle
metadata.description: HTTP, HTTP2, HTTPS, Websocket debugging proxy

summary.zh: whistle 是基于 Node.js 的跨平台网络抓包工具，支持 HTTP、HTTPS、WebSocket 等协议的请求修改。提供规则配置与一站式管理，适用于桌面及无界面服务器环境的高效网络调试。
summary.en: whistle is a powerful, cross-platform network debugging proxy built on Node.js, supporting HTTP, HTTPS, HTTP/2, and WebSocket protocols. It enables packet capture and flexible request/response modification via rules, providing a one-stop UI, plugin extensibility, and seamless support for both desktop applications and headless server environments.

metadata.name: go-rename
metadata.description: go-rename 照片视频重命名工具 支持Windows/MacOS/Linux等各平台

summary.zh: go-rename 是基于 Golang 的跨平台照片视频重命名工具。它提取 EXIF 拍摄时间或创建时间进行智能排序，支持 MD5 去重，专为解决相机与手机照片重名、难以整理的痛点而设计。
summary.en: go-rename is a robust, highly efficient, and cross-platform utility built with Golang, designed to streamline the organization of massive photo and video libraries. By automatically extracting EXIF shooting metadata, creation timestamps, or calculating MD5 hashes, it renames files chronologically, detects duplicates, and intelligently avoids filename collisions. Serving as an essential desktop automation tool, it empowers users to cleanly archive media across Windows, MacOS, and Linux platforms with minimal effort.

metadata.name: free-proxy-list
metadata.description: 🚀 Free HTTP, SOCKS4, & SOCKS5 proxy list * Updated every 5 minutes * and rotating proxy API (100+ countries)

summary.zh: 提供全球海量免费代理，每5分钟自动更新验证，涵盖HTTP、HTTPS及SOCKS协议，覆盖141国。支持多格式与NPM集成，是网页爬虫、数据采集和匿名访问的高效基础设施。
summary.en: Proxifly provides a massive, highly reliable list of free HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS4, and SOCKS5 proxies, sourced globally and rigorously validated every five minutes to ensure top-tier availability. Spanning over 141 countries with zero duplicates, the data is accessible in JSON, CSV, and text formats, alongside a rotating proxy API. This robust infrastructure is ideal for developers looking to scale web scraping, automate data collection, and conduct secure anonymous operations.

metadata.name: TVAPP
metadata.description: 收集全网 Android TV电视盒子应用，涵盖影视、直播、K歌、工具、游戏等类型，整理优质APK资源，支持便捷下载与自动更新。提供安全验证、分类索引与兼容性标注，助力用户打造家庭影音娱乐中心！              ✅ TVBox/影视仓等影音壳接口配置源。

summary.zh: 收集整理全网优质 Android TV 应用，涵盖影视、直播、游戏及工具等。提供便捷下载、自动更新、安全验证与兼容性标注，并分享 TVBox 等接口配置源，助您打造家庭影音中心。
summary.en: Curated Android TV apps for video, live, games, and tools. Features direct downloads, auto-updates, security checks, and shared TVBox API sources for home entertainment.

metadata.name: GitHubDaily
metadata.description: 坚持分享 GitHub 上高质量、有趣实用的开源技术教程、开发者工具、编程网站、技术资讯。A list cool, interesting projects of GitHub.

summary.zh: GitHubDaily 自 2015 年起聚合 GitHub 优质开源项目，涵盖教程、工具和网站，通过多社交媒体分享，助开发者掌握技术动态、提升编程能力。已累计推荐超万个项目，并提供年度复盘分类，方便快速查找。
summary.en: GitHubDaily is a community aggregating high-quality GitHub open-source projects since 2015, sharing tutorials, tools, and websites via multiple social media platforms. With over 10,000 recommendations and annual review categories, it helps developers discover trends, stay updated, and improve skills.

metadata.name: pansou
metadata.description: PanSou是一款高性能的网盘资源搜索API服务，支持TG频道和插件搜索。系统设计以性能和可扩展性为核心，支持多频道多插件并发搜索、结果智能排序和网盘类型分类。docker集成前后端，一键启动，开箱即用。仅供学习研究，请勿以各种形式用于盈利目的。 https://t.me/s/webhtv

summary.zh: PanSou 是高性能网盘资源搜索 API 服务，支持 TG 频道和自定义插件并发搜索，具备智能排序与网盘类型分类。采用异步插件系统与二级缓存，大幅提升响应速度。Docker 集成前后端，一键启动，开箱即用。仅供学习研究，禁止商用。
summary.en: PanSou is a high-performance cloud storage search API service that supports concurrent searches across Telegram channels and custom plugins. It features intelligent ranking, disk-type classification, asynchronous plugin system, and two-level caching for fast response. Docker integrates frontend and backend for one-click deployment. For learning and research only, commercial use prohibited.

metadata.name: chinese-independent-developer
metadata.description: 👩🏿‍💻👨🏾‍💻👩🏼‍💻👨🏽‍💻👩🏻‍💻中国独立开发者项目列表 -- 分享大家都在做什么

summary.zh: 本仓库是一个中国独立开发者项目聚合平台，收集了众多开发者分享的网站和应用，涵盖AI工具、桌面应用、浏览器插件等多种类型，旨在展示独立开发者的创意和成果，促进技术交流与灵感启发，帮助开发者发现优秀项目并获取创作灵感。
summary.en: This repository is a Chinese independent developer project aggregation platform, collecting various websites and applications shared by developers, covering AI tools, desktop applications, browser extensions, and more. It aims to showcase the creativity and achievements of independent developers, promote technical exchange and inspiration, helping developers discover outstanding projects and gain creative inspiration.

summary.zh: 本项目是一个基于 Java 的物联网解决方案，专为斐讯 R1 音箱设计。通过 Docker 容器化部署，简化安装与管理，适用于智能家居场景，实现远程控制与自动化集成。技术亮点包括高效的 Java 后端和容器化技术，确保跨平台兼容性和高可用性。
summary.en: This project is a Java-based IoT solution tailored for the Phicomm R1 speaker. It utilizes Docker containerization for easy deployment and management, suitable for smart home applications to enable remote control and automation. Key technical highlights include an efficient Java backend and containerization for cross-platform compatibility and reliability.

metadata.name: OpenList
metadata.description: A new AList Fork to Anti Trust Crisis

summary.zh: OpenList是AList的社区驱动分支，旨在应对开源信任危机。它支持多种云存储和本地存储，可作为个人或企业自建网盘的解决方案。采用AGPL-3.0许可证，确保完全开源透明，适合需要统一管理多网盘的文件服务器场景。
summary.en: OpenList is a community-driven fork of AList, built to defend open source against trust-based attacks. It supports multiple cloud storages and local storage, enabling users to build their own cloud drive aggregation services. Licensed under AGPL-3.0, it guarantees complete code openness and modification transparency, making it suitable for personal or enterprise file server deployments.

metadata.name: BiliTools
metadata.description: 本项目已停止维护。

summary.zh: BiliTools是一款专注于哔哩哔哩视频解析与下载的桌面应用，核心价值在于提供便捷的自动化内容抓取。其技术亮点包括直观的图形界面与高效的后台下载引擎。但因收到平台侵权指控，项目现已正式停止维护。
summary.en: BiliTools is a desktop tool for automated Bilibili video downloading and parsing. It officially ceased maintenance due to platform legal claims of infringement.

metadata.name: ai-goofish-monitor
metadata.description: 基于 Playwright 和AI实现的闲鱼多任务实时/定时监控与智能分析系统，配备了功能完善的后台管理UI。帮助用户从闲鱼海量商品中，找到心仪产品。

summary.zh: 基于 Playwright 和 AI 的闲鱼多任务监控系统，结合多模态模型深度分析商品，帮助用户从海量数据中精准筛选心仪产品。提供自然语言创建任务、Web 管理界面、即时通知和定时调度，支持 Docker 部署，是二手交易的高效自动化工具。
summary.en: Based on Playwright and AI, this Xianyu monitoring system supports multi-task real-time monitoring and intelligent analysis. It uses multimodal models to deeply analyze products, helping users filter desired items from massive data. With natural language task creation, Web UI, instant notifications, and scheduling, it supports Docker deployment, serving as an efficient automation tool for second-hand trading.

metadata.name: Deadpool
metadata.description: deadpool代理池工具，可从hunter、quake、fofa等网络空间测绘平台取高质量socks5代理，或本地导入socks5代理，轮询使用代理进行流量转发。

summary.zh: Deadpool是一款基于Go语言的代理池工具，可从hunter、quake、fofa等网络空间测绘平台自动采集高质量SOCKS5代理，支持本地导入与去重校验，通过随机轮询实现流量转发与IP切换，适用于渗透测试中规避IP封禁，提升攻击隐蔽性与稳定性。
summary.en: Deadpool is a Go-based proxy pool tool that automatically harvests high-quality SOCKS5 proxies from cyber space intelligence platforms like hunter, quake, and fofa. It supports local proxy import, health checks, and round-robin traffic forwarding, making it ideal for penetration testing to bypass IP bans and ensure stable, stealthy operations.

metadata.name: yt-dlp
metadata.description: A feature-rich command-line audio/video downloader

summary.zh: yt-dlp 是一款功能强大的跨平台命令行音视频下载工具，支持数千个站点。它集成了先进的爬虫解析、格式转换、元数据处理与插件系统，是实现高效多媒体自动化采集与归档的终极工具。
summary.en: yt-dlp is a highly feature-rich, cross-platform command-line downloader supporting high-fidelity audio and video extraction from thousands of global websites. As an active, robust fork of youtube-dl, it delivers powerful format filtering, metadata modification, plugin extensibility, and customizable post-processing workflows. It stands as the premier open-source solution for automated media collection, large-scale archiving, and efficient streaming acquisition.

metadata.name: ChinaTextbook
metadata.description: 所有小初高、大学PDF教材。

summary.zh: 本仓库全面整理并开源了覆盖小学、初中、高中直至大学的完整中文PDF教材。项目致力于打破教育资源信息壁垒，抵制中间商盗卖加水印资源的行为，促进教育公平，并方便海外华人子弟系统获取与学习国内课程。
summary.en: This repository comprehensively collects and open-sources complete Chinese PDF textbooks spanning primary, junior high, senior high, and university levels. By centralizing these vital educational assets, the project aims to dismantle information barriers, combat the commercial exploitation of watermarked resources, and promote global educational equity. It also serves as a vital bridge, enabling overseas Chinese families to easily access high-quality domestic curricula and help younger generations maintain a strong connection to Chinese heritage. This open initiative is entirely free, ensuring that economic status never limits access to foundational learning materials.

metadata.name: proxy-scraper
metadata.description: ⭐️ A proxy scraper made using Protractor | Proxy list Updates every three hour 🔥

summary.zh: 本工具基于Protractor自动化测试框架实现代理网页爬虫，定时抓取并更新代理列表，支持TXT、JSON、CSV等多格式输出，可按SOCKS5、HTTP等类型分类，适用于需要稳定代理服务的开发者，提升网络请求的匿名性与安全性。
summary.en: This tool, built on Protractor, is an automated proxy scraper that fetches and updates proxy lists every three hours. It supports multiple output formats (TXT, JSON, CSV, XML, YAML) and categorizes proxies by type (SOCKS5, SOCKS4, HTTP). Ideal for developers requiring reliable proxies for enhanced anonymity and security in network operations.

metadata.name: PROXY-List
metadata.description: Get PROXY List  that gets updated everyday

summary.zh: 该仓库提供每日更新的免费公共代理列表，收集自互联网，支持SOCKS5、SOCKS4和HTTP协议，总代理数7223个。适用于需要匿名访问网络或绕过限制的场景，如网页爬虫或自动化工具。技术亮点包括提供直接下载链接和配套检查工具。仅用于教育目的。
summary.en: This repository provides a daily-updated list of free public proxies collected from the internet, supporting SOCKS5, SOCKS4, and HTTP protocols, with 7223 proxies. It is useful for anonymous web access or bypassing restrictions, such as in web crawling or automation tasks. Key features include easy download links and a tool to check proxy validity. For educational purposes only.

metadata.name: lx-music-mobile
metadata.description: 一个基于 React native 开发的音乐软件

summary.zh: LX Music 移动版是一款基于 React Native 和 Redux 开发的 Android 音乐播放应用，允许用户通过自定义源自由播放音乐，并可选配自建同步服务实现多端数据同步。软件面向高级用户，提供丰富定制选项，但默认设置不追求新手友好。
summary.en: LX Music Mobile is an Android music player developed with React Native and Redux, enabling users to play music via customizable sources and optionally sync data across devices via a self-hosted service. It targets advanced users with extensive customization options, though not beginner-friendly by default.

metadata.name: Bulk-Crap-Uninstaller
metadata.description: Remove large amounts of unwanted applications quickly.

summary.zh: BCUninstaller 是一款免费开源的 Windows 批量程序快速卸载工具，专为高效移除大量无用软件而设计。它支持智能清理残留、检测孤儿应用，并完美兼容 Windows Store、Steam 及多种主流安装格式，是系统批量清理与日常维护的得力助手。
summary.en: Bulk Crap Uninstaller (BCUninstaller) is a free, open-source Windows utility designed for rapidly removing large amounts of unwanted applications. It excels at cleaning up leftovers, detecting orphaned software, and supporting Windows Store, Steam, and various installer formats, streamlining system maintenance and batch cleanup.

metadata.name: lxmusic-
metadata.description: lxmusic(洛雪音乐)全网最新最全音源

summary.zh: 本仓库专注于为洛雪音乐（LX Music）跨平台桌面播放器提供全网最新、最全的音源解析与配置方案，助力用户轻松畅听海量无损音乐，并提供付费定制音源与活跃的社区运维支持。
summary.en: This repository provides the latest and most comprehensive music sources and parsing scripts for the cross-platform LX Music desktop player, enabling seamless streaming of vast music libraries with active community maintenance and premium options.

metadata.name: breezy-weather
metadata.description: A feature-rich weather app with good visualizations and more than 50 sources.

summary.zh: 一款基于Kotlin和Jetpack Compose构建的开源天气应用，集成超50个天气源。通过Material 3精美的数据可视化，提供预报、空气质量、花粉和警报等全面服务，打造优雅实用的移动端天气体验。
summary.en: Breezy Weather is a highly feature-rich, completely free, and open-source Android weather application built using modern Kotlin and Jetpack Compose technologies. It supports more than 50 weather sources, offering stunning visualizations for forecasts, observations, nowcasting, air quality, pollen, and alerts. Designed with Material 3 Expressive guidelines, the app provides an elegant, highly customizable, and intuitive user interface, ensuring users can easily track and enjoy beautiful meteorological data visualizations in real time on their devices, providing a seamless experience.

metadata.name: GitHubDesktop2Chinese
metadata.description: GithubDesktop语言本地化(汉化)工具 【GitHub桌面客户端中文汉化】

summary.zh: 该工具通过正则匹配与JSON配置自动将GitHub Desktop界面文本替换为中文，兼容频繁版本更新且维护成本低。支持选择性替换、预览版、代理与断点续传，助力中文用户快速完成GitHub Desktop汉化。
summary.en: This tool automatically replaces GitHub Desktop interface text with Chinese via regex matching and JSON configuration, ensuring high compatibility with frequent updates and low maintenance. It supports selective replacement, preview features, proxy, and resumable downloads, ideal for Chinese users to localize GitHub Desktop.

metadata.name: DailyHotApi
metadata.description: 🔥 今日热榜 API，一个聚合热门数据的 API 接口，支持 RSS 模式 及 Vercel 部署 | 前端页面：https://github.com/imsyy/DailyHot

summary.zh: 今日热榜 API 聚合多平台热门数据，提供 JSON 和 RSS 接口，简化热点获取。支持 Vercel、Docker 部署，响应迅速，路由清晰，易于扩展，适用于构建聚合网站、RSS 阅读器等应用。
summary.en: DailyHotApi aggregates trending data from multiple platforms, providing JSON and RSS interfaces to simplify hot topic access. It supports Vercel and Docker deployments, with fast response, clear routing, and easy extension, suitable for building aggregation sites, RSS readers, and similar applications.

metadata.name: notepad--
metadata.description: 一个支持windows/linux/mac的文本编辑器，目标是做中国人自己的编辑器，来自中国。

summary.zh: Notepad-- 是一款轻量级跨平台文本编辑器，支持Windows、Linux和Mac系统，核心目标是实现文本编辑软件的国产可替代，重点服务于国产信创Uos系统。其技术亮点在于跨平台兼容性，提供稳定高效的编辑体验，助力软件自主可控，适用于日常文本处理和代码编写场景，促进国产软件生态发展。
summary.en: Notepad-- is a lightweight cross-platform text editor supporting Windows, Linux, and Mac, aimed at providing a domestic alternative for text editing software in China. It focuses on国产信创Uos system and other Linux distributions, leveraging cross-platform compatibility to offer reliable and efficient editing for daily text processing and coding, thereby promoting software autonomy.

metadata.name: BPB-Worker-Panel
metadata.description: A GUI Panel providing Worker subscriptions for VLESS, Trojan and Warp configs alongside a private DoH server and chain proxies, offering full DNS, clean IP,  Fragment, Warp, Warp pro and routing settings for cross-platform clients using Amnezia, Wireguard, Sing-box, Clash/Mihomo and Xray cores.

summary.zh: BPB-Worker-Panel 是基于 Cloudflare Worker 的免费私密代理面板，提供 VLESS、Trojan、Warp 配置及私有 DoH 服务器，支持跨平台客户端。其亮点包括丰富路由规则、链式代理、Fragment 与 Warp Pro，适用于科学上网与隐私保护，具备高度可定制性和广泛兼容性。
summary.en: BPB-Worker-Panel is a free, private proxy panel built on Cloudflare Worker, offering VLESS, Trojan, and Warp configs with a private DoH server. It supports cross-platform clients, featuring rich routing rules, chain proxies, Fragment, and Warp Pro. Ideal for secure browsing and bypassing restrictions, it provides high customizability and broad compatibility.

metadata.name: SaveAny-Bot
metadata.description: Save Any Telegram File to Anywhere 📂 (Alist, Disk, Webdav, S3, Rclone...) . Support restrict saving content and files beyond telegram.

summary.zh: 一款强大的 Telegram 文件自动归档机器人，支持突破保存限制，将文件批量流式传输至 Alist、S3、WebDAV 等多存储后端。集成 yt-dlp 与 Aria2，实现跨平台媒体自动化下载与智能整理。
summary.en: SaveAny Bot is a robust Telegram file archiving tool that bypasses saving restrictions, supporting batch streaming to multiple backends like Alist, S3, WebDAV, and local disks. Integrated with yt-dlp and Aria2, it automates cross-platform media downloads, chat monitoring, and intelligent file organization.

metadata.name: Douyin_TikTok_Download_API
metadata.description: 🚀 抖音、TikTok 数据采集与无水印视频下载 API，自托管，支持 MCP 调用与 Docker 一键部署。| Self-hosted TikTok & Douyin scraper and no-watermark video downloader — async REST API, MCP server, CLI and web console for posts, profiles, comments and playlists. Self-healing identity pool, PostgreSQL archive, one docker compose up.

summary.zh: 自托管的抖音与TikTok无水印视频下载及数据采集API，支持Docker一键部署。集成自愈身份池与PostgreSQL，提供异步REST与MCP接口，适用于AI数据收集与自动化内容管理。
summary.en: This self-hosted solution provides a powerful API for scraping Douyin and TikTok, enabling seamless, watermark-free video and image downloads alongside rich metadata collection. With one-click Docker deployment, it features a resilient self-healing identity pool, PostgreSQL archiving, and supports asynchronous REST APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP), CLI, and an intuitive web console. It is ideal for developers and researchers looking to automate content aggregation, power next-generation AI model training with rich social datasets, and execute large-scale social media analytics with complete data privacy and zero vendor lock-in.

metadata.name: HotPEToolBox
metadata.description: 一个纯净、强大、优雅的WinPE

summary.zh: HotPE构建工具箱旨在生成纯净、强大且优雅的Win11 PE环境。支持网络、声音、远程控制、MTP、BitLocker解锁及ISO生成等丰富功能，是进行系统维护、部署和故障恢复的高效解决方案。
summary.en: HotPEToolBox is a powerful build tool to generate a pure, elegant, and feature-rich Win11 PE environment. It supports networking, audio, remote access, MTP, BitLocker unlocking, and ISO burning, ideal for system deployment, recovery, and maintenance.

metadata.name: HelloGitHub
metadata.description: :octocat: 分享 GitHub 上有趣、入门级的开源项目。Share interesting, entry-level open source projects on GitHub.

summary.zh: HelloGitHub 是一个专注于分享 GitHub 上有趣、入门级开源项目的社区。通过月刊形式聚合开源书籍、实战及企业级项目，旨在降低开源门槛，帮助开发者快速感受开源魅力，激发编程兴趣。
summary.en: HelloGitHub is a highly influential, curated community platform dedicated to sharing interesting and entry-level open source projects on GitHub. By releasing carefully edited monthly newsletters, it aggregates diverse resources such as practical coding projects, open source books, and enterprise-level applications. Its ultimate goal is to lower the technical barrier, allowing developers and beginners to easily explore high-quality repositories, feel the collaborative charm of open source, and spark their lasting interest in programming. It serves as an essential gateway for developers to discover awesome tools and libraries.

metadata.name: NetMount
metadata.description: 统一管理和挂载云存储设施/Unified management and mounting of cloud storage facilities

summary.zh: NetMount 是一款基于 Tauri 的跨平台桌面工具，专注于统一管理和本地挂载各类云存储。它集成 Rclone 与 OpenList，将云端资源转化为本地驱动器，显著提升多云环境下的数据访问与管理效率。
summary.en: NetMount is a cross-platform desktop tool built with Tauri, focusing on the unified management and local mounting of diverse cloud storage services. Integrating Rclone and OpenList, it transforms cloud resources into local drivers, significantly boosting data access and management efficiency in multi-cloud environments.

metadata.name: GoGoGo
metadata.description: 一个基于 Android 调试 API + 百度地图实现的虚拟定位工具，并且同时实现了一个可以自由移动的摇杆

summary.zh: 影梭是一个基于 Android 调试 API 和百度地图 SDK 的虚拟定位工具，无需 ROOT 权限，可自由修改当前位置并模拟移动。支持摇杆控制、历史记录、位置搜索等功能，适用于学习 Android 开发和地图应用。技术亮点在于利用调试 API 实现非 ROOT 定位修改。
summary.en: GoGoGo is a virtual positioning tool based on Android Debug API and Baidu Map SDK, requiring no ROOT permissions. It allows free modification of current location and simulated movement, with features like joystick control, history records, and location search. Designed for learning Android development and map integration, its key technical highlight is achieving non-ROOT positioning via debug APIs.

metadata.name: Cloudflare-vless-trojan
metadata.description: CF-workers/pages代理脚本：支持Vless-ws(tls)、Trojan-ws(tls)；Socks5/http本地代理脚本：可选ECH-TLS、普通TLS、无TLS三种代理模式

summary.zh: 基于Cloudflare Workers/Pages，提供Vless和Trojan代理的本地化部署脚本。支持WebSocket over TLS及多种代理模式，无需第三方订阅，利用官方IP实现稳定节点。适用于科学上网，具有抗封锁、配置简便的优势。
summary.en: Based on Cloudflare Workers/Pages, this provides a local deployment script for Vless and Trojan proxies. It supports WebSocket over TLS and multiple proxy modes, without requiring third-party subscriptions, leveraging official IPs for stable nodes. Suitable for circumvention, it offers anti-censorship and easy configuration.

metadata.name: NoMoreWalls
metadata.description: 自动抓取合并互联网上的公开节点。

summary.zh: 自动抓取并实时合并互联网上的公开代理节点，生成优化的 Clash Meta 订阅列表。集成智能分流、恶意网站拦截机制与反 996 伦理许可，致力于提供免费、安全、高效的跨墙网络访问与自动化节点聚合服务。
summary.en: Automatically fetches and merges public proxy nodes from the internet to generate optimized Clash Meta subscription lists. It features smart routing rules, malicious site blocking, and an anti-996 ethical license, providing a free, secure, and efficient solution for circumventing network restrictions and automated node aggregation.

metadata.name: iptv-api
metadata.description: ⚡️ IPTV直播源自动更新工具：自动采集、校验、测速并生成可播放结果，支持 M3U/TXT/API 输出、自定义频道、IPv4/IPv6、Docker、GitHub Actions、CLI 与 GUI 多端部署

summary.zh: IPTV直播源自动化采集与智能测速工具，支持多源聚合、可用性校验与自定义频道。可输出M3U、TXT及API，结合Docker与GUI跨平台部署，助您轻松构建高质量个性化直播列表。
summary.en: An automated IPTV stream aggregation and testing tool that collects, validates, and speed-tests live sources to generate customizable M3U, TXT, and API outputs. With Docker, CLI, and GUI support, it enables easy cross-platform deployment for building high-quality personalized channel lists.

metadata.name: cf-proxy-ex
metadata.description: Cloudflare超级代理，无服务器代理，Duckduckgo代理（可用AI聊天，包含GPT4o/Claude3），Github加速，支持解锁Libgen，在线代理。现已支持多平台部署。Cloudflare super proxy, setting up a free serverless proxy by using Cloudflare worker, support Duckduckgo / Libgen. Now you can deploy this project on different platforms.

summary.zh: Cloudflare Proxy EX 是一款基于Cloudflare Worker的无服务器在线代理，支持DuckDuckGo AI聊天（GPT4o/Claude3）、GitHub加速和Libgen解锁。通过多平台部署和Cookie管理，实现完整网页加载与安全访问，适用于突破网络限制和提升访问体验。
summary.en: Cloudflare Proxy EX is a serverless reverse proxy built on Cloudflare Workers, providing DuckDuckGo AI chat (GPT4o/Claude3), GitHub acceleration, and Libgen unlocking. It supports multi-platform deployment, cookie scoping, and full web resource loading, ensuring secure and unrestricted access.

metadata.name: taosync
metadata.description: TaoSync是一个适用于OpenList v3+的自动化同步工具/Sync for OpenList/AList

summary.zh: TaoSync是一款基于Python和Vue的跨平台自动同步工具，内置存储引擎并兼容OpenList。支持本地与云盘间的定时备份、增量同步及自动下载，适用于个人数据保护与多端高效流转。
summary.en: TaoSync is a highly versatile, cross-platform automated data synchronization tool designed to streamline personal and cloud storage management. Built with a robust Python backend and a dynamic Vue frontend, it features a built-in storage engine while offering seamless compatibility with OpenList and AList v3+. It supports various synchronization modes, including full sync, incremental backup, and scheduled off-peak downloads across Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android, providing users with a powerful, secure, and highly flexible solution for automated data protection and multi-cloud workflow integration.

metadata.name: httpsok
metadata.description: 🔥🔥🔥一行命令，轻松搞定SSL证书自动续期。 SSL泛域名证书，SSL证书管理，SSL证书自动续期，SSL证书自动更新，七牛云、阿里云、腾讯云、CDN、OSS、https证书管理,https证书管理,免费SSL证书,TLS证书自动续签,nginx证书自动续期工具，nginx证书管理。从此告别Let's Encrypt

summary.zh: httpsok 是一款专为 Nginx、Apache 等服务器设计的 SSL 证书自动续期工具，通过一行命令简化证书管理流程。支持泛域名、多服务器及主流云厂商集成，具备自动检测配置、证书监控等功能，兼容多种系统和容器环境，确保企业级安全稳定。
summary.en: httpsok is an SSL certificate auto-renewal tool designed for Nginx, Apache servers, simplifying management with a single command. It supports wildcard certificates, multi-server setups, and cloud integrations, featuring auto-detection, monitoring, and broad compatibility for secure production use.

metadata.name: tvbox
metadata.description: OK影视、tvbox配置文件，如果喜欢，请Fork自用。使用前请仔细阅读仓库说明，一旦使用将被视为你已了解。

summary.zh: 本仓库提供TVBox应用的配置文件，核心价值在于集成多个影视资源源，简化用户配置过程，适用于电视盒子和移动设备上的影视播放，技术亮点包括多种配置选项、自定义代理支持及详细使用指南。
summary.en: This repository provides configuration files for TVBox applications, with core value in aggregating multiple影视资源 sources to simplify user setup. It is applicable for影视播放 on TV boxes and mobile devices, featuring diverse configuration options, custom proxy support, and detailed usage instructions.

metadata.name: ecs
metadata.description: VPS 融合怪服务器测评脚本 —— 更推荐使用无环境依赖的 Go 版本：https://github.com/oneclickvirt/ecs VPS Fusion Monster Server Test Script — we now recommend the Go version (zero external dependencies): https://github.com/oneclickvirt/ecs

summary.zh: 该脚本是面向VPS服务器的综合性能测评工具，集成网络测速、IP质量检测、回程路由测试等多项功能。支持Ubuntu、Debian、CentOS等多操作系统及amd64、arm64等多架构，适用于云服务器性能评估与网络质量监控。提供交互与参数两种模式，助力运维人员快速诊断服务器状态。
summary.en: This script is a comprehensive performance testing tool for VPS servers, integrating functions like network speed testing, IP quality detection, and return route tracing. It supports multiple operating systems such as Ubuntu, Debian, CentOS, and architectures including amd64 and arm64, making it suitable for cloud server performance evaluation and network quality monitoring. It offers both interactive and parameter modes, helping operators quickly diagnose server status.

metadata.name: Sandboxie
metadata.description: Sandboxie Plus & Classic

summary.zh: Sandboxie是Windows平台的沙盒隔离工具，通过创建虚拟安全环境隔离运行程序，保护系统注册表与文件免受修改。适用于安全测试不受信任的软件与网页浏览，提供Plus和Classic双版本，确保主机安全。
summary.en: Sandboxie is a robust sandbox-based isolation software designed for Windows operating systems. It creates a secure, virtualized container environment where applications can be run and installed without making permanent changes to the local system registry or hard drives. This tool is perfect for testing untrusted software, protecting privacy during web browsing, and isolating processes from the host system. It is offered in two editions, Plus and Classic, sharing the same core security engine but offering different user interfaces and feature sets to cater to different user needs.

metadata.name: awesome-cloudflare
metadata.description: ⛅️ 精选的 Cloudflare 工具、开源项目、指南、博客和其他资源列表。/ ⛅️ A curated list of Cloudflare tools, open source projects, guides, blogs and other resources.

summary.zh: 精选基于 Cloudflare 的开源工具与项目，覆盖图床、邮箱、短链、加速、存储等场景，为独立开发者提供省心的资源导航。助其快速部署简单高效的解决方案，降低成本，提升效率。持续更新，欢迎贡献。
summary.en: A curated list of Cloudflare-based open-source tools and projects, covering image hosting, email, URL shortening, acceleration, storage, and more. It provides a hassle-free resource navigator for indie developers, helping them quickly deploy simple, efficient solutions to reduce costs and boost productivity. Continuously updated, contributions welcome.

metadata.name: proxypin
metadata.description: Open source free capture HTTP(S) traffic  software ProxyPin, supporting full platform systems

summary.zh: ProxyPin是一款基于Flutter的跨平台开源免费HTTP(S)抓包工具，支持全平台系统。它提供扫码连接、域名过滤、脚本处理、请求重写与AES解密等强大功能，界面美观，是开发者调试网络流量的理想工具。
summary.en: ProxyPin is an open-source, free, and powerful cross-platform tool designed to capture, inspect, and rewrite HTTP(S) traffic across Windows, Mac, Android, iOS, and Linux. Developed using Flutter, it provides a beautiful and intuitive user interface. Key features include mobile QR code connection, domain filtering, JavaScript scripting, request mapping, AES decryption, and comprehensive HAR history export, serving as a versatile network debugging solution for developers who need to optimize workflows and troubleshoot network issues efficiently.

metadata.name: adblockfilters
metadata.description: 去广告合并规则，每8个小时更新一次。

summary.zh: 本项目定时自动合并、去重并清洗上游广告过滤规则，通过DNS解析剔除失效域名，生成高效轻量的多格式DNS拦截列表。适用于AdGuard、浏览器插件及各类DNS服务，提升去广告效果与运行效率。
summary.en: This project automatically merges, deduplicates, and cleans upstream ad-blocking rules on a regular basis, using DNS resolution to filter out dead domains. It generates lightweight, multi-format DNS blocking lists compatible with AdGuard, browser extensions, and various DNS services, optimizing ad-blocking efficiency.

metadata.name: FreeNodes
metadata.description: v2ray、clash免费节点爬虫，自动更新

summary.zh: FreeNodes是一个AI驱动的v2ray和Clash免费节点爬虫，每日自动从多个网站爬取节点信息，生成txt和yaml格式的订阅列表，并提供镜像加速链接。其核心价值在于自动化节点更新，适用于学习交流场景，技术亮点包括AI集成、多格式支持和定时调度，是网络代理用户的实用工具。
summary.en: FreeNodes is an AI-powered crawler for v2ray and Clash free nodes, running daily to fetch nodes from various sources, generating subscription lists in txt and yaml formats with mirror acceleration links. Its core value is automated node updating for educational purposes, featuring AI integration, multi-format support, and scheduled task execution, serving as a practical tool for network proxy users.

metadata.name: GOODBYEADS
metadata.description: 适用于AdGuard、Quantumult X、SmartDNS的去广告规则，合并优质上游规则并去重整理排列。

summary.zh: 该项目是一个去广告规则集合，适用于AdGuard、Quantumult X、SmartDNS等多种网络工具。它合并了众多优质上游规则，进行去重和排序，提供定时更新。规则数量庞大，包含拦截规则、DNS拦截规则和白名单，有效屏蔽广告，提升网络浏览体验。
summary.en: This project is a collection of ad-blocking rules compatible with AdGuard, Quantumult X, SmartDNS, and more. It merges high-quality upstream rules, deduplicates and organizes them, offering scheduled updates. With a vast number of rules, including blocking, DNS blocking, and whitelists, it effectively blocks ads and improves browsing experience.

metadata.name: TikTokDownloader
metadata.description: 抖音 / TikTok 平台作品下载/数据采集工具

summary.zh: DouK-Downloader 是一款功能强大的抖音与 TikTok 平台作品下载与数据采集工具。它支持高清视频、图集、直播流及合集的批量下载，并提供评论采集、数据持久化（CSV/SQLite）、多线程下载与 Web UI 界面。适用于个人存档、数据分析与自动化运营，部署灵活，是高效的跨平台爬虫解决方案。
summary.en: DouK-Downloader is a powerful downloader and data crawler for TikTok and Douyin. It supports batch downloading of videos, albums, live streams, and collections, alongside data scraping and persistence. With multi-threading, Web UI, and API support, it's ideal for automated data collection and archiving.

metadata.name: x-ui-yg
metadata.description: x-ui精简修改版脚本，支持Hysteria2、Xhttp传输协议、ENC加密、MLDSA65加密，集成argo固定临时双隧道（可共存）、Psiphon赛风VPN（30个国家）分流功能，支持部分节点聚合订阅、sing-box订阅、clash-meta订阅的配置输出

summary.zh: 该脚本是x-ui的精简修改版，支持Hysteria2、Xhttp等先进传输协议与加密技术，集成Argo隧道和Psiphon VPN分流，提供本地节点生成与多订阅输出，适用于VPS环境下的高性能代理服务搭建，提升网络灵活性与安全性。
summary.en: This script is a streamlined modification of x-ui, supporting advanced protocols like Hysteria2 and Xhttp with encryption features. It integrates Argo tunnels and Psiphon VPN for traffic diversion, generates local nodes, and outputs subscriptions for sing-box and clash-meta. Ideal for building proxy services on VPS, it enhances network flexibility and security.

metadata.name: biliup
metadata.description: 自动直播录制、投稿、twitch、ytb频道搬运工具。命令行投稿(B站)和视频下载工具，提供多种登录方式，支持多p。边录边传0落盘

summary.zh: biliup 是自动化直播录制与投稿工具，支持 B站、抖音、Twitch、YouTube 等 19 个平台，可实现 24 小时无人值守录制、边录边传零落盘，同时抓取弹幕。采用 Python+Rust 混合开发，内置高性能下载器，提供 WebUI 界面与多用户权限管理，适用于个人及团队的内容自动化搬运与运营。
summary.en: biliup is an automated live stream recording and uploading tool that supports 19 platforms including Bilibili, Douyin, Twitch, and YouTube. It enables 24/7 unattended recording with zero-disk caching during upload, while capturing danmaku as XML. Built with Python and Rust, it features a built-in high-performance downloader, WebUI, and multi-user role management, ideal for content creators and teams seeking automated video operations.

metadata.name: Nagram
metadata.description: The third-party Telegram android app.

summary.zh: Nagram 是基于 NekoX 的第三方 Telegram 客户端，提供无限多账号、全面代理支持及合并消息、强制复制、快速回复等深度定制功能，致力于打造安全、个性化的即时通讯体验。
summary.en: Nagram is a feature-rich, third-party Android Telegram client built on the NekoX codebase, delivering a highly customizable and secure messaging experience. Key highlights include unlimited multi-account support, robust proxy integrations (VMess, Shadowsocks, SSR, Trojan, and MTProxy), and practical enhancements such as message combining, forced copy, quick replies, and scrollable chat previews. It also features advanced privacy controls, extensive translation tools, customizable text styles, and voice enhancement, making it a powerful, privacy-centric alternative for personal and group instant messaging globally. The project is licensed under GPLv3, ensuring transparency and community-driven improvements.

metadata.name: mediago
metadata.description: Cross-platform video downloader — sniff and grab m3u8/HLS streams, Bilibili, YouTube and more. Desktop + Docker + 🦞.

summary.zh: MediaGo是一款跨平台视频下载工具，内置嗅探功能可自动检测m3u8/HLS流，无需抓包或配置浏览器扩展。集成yt-dlp支持YouTube、Bilibili等千余站点，提供HTTP API和AI助手技能实现自然语言下载。支持格式转换与一键Docker部署，适用于个人及自动化视频获取场景。
summary.en: MediaGo is a cross-platform video downloader with built-in sniffing for m3u8/HLS streams, eliminating packet capture or browser extension setup. Powered by yt-dlp, it supports YouTube, Bilibili, and 1000+ sites. Features include an HTTP API, AI assistant skill for natural language commands, built-in format conversion, and one-click Docker deployment, catering to personal and automated downloading needs.

metadata.name: anti-AD
metadata.description: 致力于成为中文区命中率最高的广告过滤列表，实现精确的广告屏蔽和隐私保护。anti-AD 现已支持 AdGuardHome，dnsmasq，Surge，Pi-Hole，Clash, mihomo，smartdns，sing-box 等网络组件。完全兼容常见的广告过滤工具所支持的各种广告过滤列表格式

summary.zh: 中文区高命中率的广告过滤与隐私保护列表，基于域名解析层合并去重主流规则，全面兼容AdGuardHome、Clash等网络组件，精准屏蔽App及电视盒子广告，从DNS层守护个人隐私。
summary.en: anti-AD is a premier ad filtering and privacy protection list optimized for the Chinese region, aiming for maximum blocking accuracy. By operating at the DNS layer, it merges and deduplicates global rules to block TV box, app ads, and privacy trackers. It offers broad compatibility with AdGuardHome, Clash, Surge, and sing-box, securing user privacy at the network gateway.

metadata.name: N3RD
metadata.description: CTV

summary.zh: N3RD仓库中的CTV项目是一个专注于电视数据自动化的工具，核心价值在于通过高效的网络爬虫技术实现电视节目信息的快速采集。应用场景包括媒体内容聚合、市场研究和数据分析，技术亮点包括多线程处理、结构化数据输出和跨平台支持，确保高可靠性和易用性。
summary.en: The CTV project in the N3RD repository is an automation tool focused on TV data harvesting, providing efficient web crawling capabilities for collecting TV program information. It is applicable for media content aggregation, market research, and data analysis, with technical highlights including multi-threaded processing, structured data output, and cross-platform support for high reliability.

summary.zh: 该仓库原本是一个哔哩哔哩视频下载工具，通过逆向分析平台非公开接口与认证体系，实现付费内容、高清视频及弹幕字幕的自动化抓取。技术亮点在于绕过反爬风控与签名鉴权，适用于个人下载与研究场景。目前因侵权指控已永久关停。
summary.en: The leiurayer/downkyi repository was a Bilibili video downloader that reverse-engineered non-public interfaces and authentication systems to automate capture of paid content, HD videos, and subtitles. Key features include bypassing anti-crawler controls and signature authentication for personal use cases. It is now permanently closed due to infringement issues.

metadata.name: changedetection.io
metadata.description: Best and simplest tool for website change detection, web page monitoring, and website change alerts. Perfect for tracking content changes, price drops, restock alerts, and website defacement monitoring—all for free or enjoy our SaaS plan!

summary.zh: 开源网页内容变更检测与实时监控工具，专注价格追踪、防篡改和补货提醒。集成AI大模型实现智能过滤与自然语言摘要，支持可视化区域选择与多渠道即时警报，是高效的自动化网站监控解决方案。
summary.en: changedetection.io is a leading open-source tool designed for automated website change detection and continuous real-time web page monitoring. It is ideal for tracking content modifications, price drops, restock alerts, and website defacement. Integrating advanced AI large language models (LLMs), the tool offers smart, intent-based alert filtering and generates plain-language summaries instead of raw diffs. With support for visual selectors, word-level diffs, and multi-channel notifications like Discord, Slack, Telegram, and email, it provides a highly efficient, automated, and self-hostable solution for content surveillance.

metadata.name: rsspush
metadata.description: 监测RSS变动，并发送最新内容到微信、Webhook 和 Telegram, Discord, Slack, Amazon SNS, Gotify 等数十个消息通道。

summary.zh: RSSPush 是一款基于 Web 的应用，通过 Docker 部署，能够自动监测 RSS 源的变动，并将最新内容实时推送到微信、Telegram、Discord 等数十种消息通道。它支持 HTTP 代理、关键词过滤和自动翻译功能，集成 RSSHub 提供两千多种源选择，适用于个人和企业信息自动化推送。
summary.en: RSSPush is a web application that monitors RSS feed changes and pushes new content to multiple messaging channels like WeChat, Telegram, and Discord. It features Docker deployment, HTTP proxy support, keyword filtering, and automatic translation. Integrated with RSSHub, it offers over 2000 feed sources, ideal for automated information distribution.

metadata.name: 1Panel
metadata.description: 🔥 1Panel is a modern, open-source Linux server management panel and a lightweight AI management platform.

summary.zh: 1Panel是一款现代化开源Linux服务器管理与轻量级AI管理平台。它集可视化运维、快速建站、应用商店及统一AI网关于一体，通过直观Web界面，极大简化服务器与AI智能体的部署与日常管理。
summary.en: 1Panel is a modern, open-source Linux server management panel and lightweight AI management platform. It integrates visual server operations, one-click website deployment, a curated app store, and unified AI gateway management, simplifying the complex deployment and daily maintenance of both servers and AI agents via an intuitive web interface.

metadata.name: SmartTube
metadata.description: Browse media content with your own rules on Android TV

summary.zh: SmartTube 是一款专为 Android TV 设计的免费开源媒体客户端，核心价值在于提供无需 Google 服务的自定义媒体浏览体验。适用于所有 Android TV 和电视盒设备，支持从公共来源播放内容。技术亮点包括 SponsorBlock 集成、8K 分辨率、HDR 兼容及可自定义按钮，界面针对电视优化，提升观看灵活性。
summary.en: SmartTube is a free and open-source media client for Android TV, offering a Google-services-free experience with customizable browsing rules. It supports all Android TV and TV boxes, enabling media playback from public sources. Key features include SponsorBlock integration, 8K resolution, HDR compatibility, and customizable buttons, with a TV-optimized interface for enhanced viewing.

metadata.name: free-api
metadata.description: 收集免费的接口服务,做一个api的搬运工

summary.zh: 本仓库汇聚了丰富的免费API接口，覆盖AI大模型、天气查询、加密算法、生活服务等多个领域，旨在帮助开发者快速集成所需服务，降低开发成本。接口持续更新，支持在线调用，是开发者高效开发的实用工具集。
summary.en: This repository provides a comprehensive collection of free APIs covering AI models, weather queries, encryption algorithms, and various lifestyle services. It aims to help developers quickly integrate needed services into their projects, reducing development costs. The APIs are continuously updated and support online testing, serving as a practical toolkit for efficient development.

metadata.name: Docker_Microsoft365_E5_Renew_X
metadata.description: Docker版本的E5调用API续订服务：Microsoft 365 E5 Renew X

summary.zh: 本项目通过Docker容器化技术封装Microsoft 365 E5 Renew X服务，实现跨平台自动化订阅续订。支持多CPU架构部署，镜像轻量仅225M，提供邮件通知与一键部署功能，适用于个人学习与运维自动化场景。
summary.en: This project leverages Docker containerization to package the Microsoft 365 E5 Renew X service, enabling cross-platform automated subscription renewal. With support for multiple CPU architectures and a lightweight 225M image, it offers email notifications and one-click deployment, ideal for personal learning and DevOps automation.

metadata.name: WebMonitor
metadata.description: 实时监控网页变化，并发送通知（Monitor web page changes in real time and send notifications）

summary.zh: WebMonitor 是一款功能强大的实时网页变化监控工具，支持动态抓取与多选择器提取，集成微信、Telegram、Slack等多渠道即时通知。适用于新闻追踪、价格监控及RSS更新，通过可视化操作与自定义规则，助您实现高效的信息自动化监控。
summary.en: WebMonitor is a robust real-time web page monitoring tool that supports dynamic content fetching and flexible data extraction. It integrates multi-channel notifications (Telegram, Slack, WeChat) and custom rules, making it ideal for news tracking, price monitoring, and RSS updates, enabling highly efficient automated information surveillance.

metadata.name: ContextMenuManager
metadata.description: 🖱️ 纯粹的Windows右键菜单管理程序

summary.zh: 这是一款纯粹的Windows右键菜单管理工具，支持对文件、文件夹、发送到等场景的菜单项进行启用、禁用、修改及自定义操作。基于.NET开发，兼容Win7至Win10系统，助力用户高效整理和优化系统右键菜单。
summary.en: A clean and powerful Windows context menu manager for enabling, disabling, modifying, and customizing menu items across files, folders, and 'send to' scenarios. Built with .NET, it supports Windows 7 through 10, helping users efficiently organize and optimize system right-click menus.

metadata.name: v2ray-heroku
metadata.description: 用于在 Heroku 上部署 V2Ray WebSocket。

summary.zh: 本项目实现在Heroku平台部署V2Ray WebSocket代理服务，通过配置ID和路径即可快速生成稳定代理节点，支持CloudFlare加速，适用于科学上网场景，且能自动保持V2Ray版本更新。
summary.en: This project deploys V2Ray WebSocket proxy on Heroku, enabling quick setup of stable proxy nodes via ID and path configuration. It supports CloudFlare acceleration for improved performance, ensures automatic V2Ray version updates, and is suitable for network proxy needs.

metadata.name: ShareX
metadata.description: ShareX is a free and open-source application that enables users to capture or record any area of their screen with a single keystroke. It also supports uploading images, text, and various file types to a wide range of destinations.

summary.zh: ShareX是一款免费开源的轻量级桌面工具，集屏幕截图、视频录制、图像编辑、OCR识别与自动化文件分享于一体。它通过高度自定义的热键和工作流，显著提升开发者与创意工作者的效率。
summary.en: ShareX is a powerful, free, and open-source desktop application designed for seamless screen capture, recording, and file sharing. It integrates robust image editing, OCR text extraction, and highly customizable automation workflows. Lightweight and advertisement-free, it is ideal for developers, designers, and content creators seeking to streamline their productivity.

metadata.name: FileCentipede
metadata.description: Cross-platform internet upload/download manager for HTTP(S), FTP(S), SSH, magnet-link, BitTorrent, m3u8, ed2k, and online videos.  WebDAV client, FTP client, SSH client.

summary.zh: FileCentipede是一款跨平台、全协议的桌面端网络传输与下载管理工具。它支持HTTP、FTP、SSH、BT及磁力链接等主流协议，集成多种客户端。其亮点是浏览器扩展，能智能抓取网页音视频，内置丰富辅助工具，提供高效的一站式多协议下载体验。
summary.en: FileCentipede is a powerful, cross-platform, all-in-one internet file transfer and download manager designed for high speed and customization. It offers comprehensive support for a wide range of protocols, including HTTP(S), FTP(S), SSH, BitTorrent, magnet links, m3u8, and ed2k, integrating WebDAV, FTP, and SSH clients under a single interface. Its standout feature is the browser extension, which allows users to easily capture audio, video, and other resources from websites, even encrypted ones. Packed with auxiliary tools like HTTP requesters and file checksums, it provides an efficient, one-stop solution for complex downloading tasks.

metadata.name: v2rayN
metadata.description: A GUI client for Windows, Linux and macOS, support Xray and sing-box and others

summary.zh: v2rayN 是跨平台 GUI 客户端，支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS，集成 Xray、sing-box 等多种代理核心。它提供直观的配置界面与规则管理，适用于科学上网与网络调试。项目具备 GPG 签名校验和多架构支持，是用户高效搭建代理服务的可靠工具。
summary.en: v2rayN is a cross-platform GUI client that supports Windows, Linux, and macOS. It integrates multiple proxy cores, such as Xray and sing-box, offering an intuitive configuration interface and rule management for scientific browsing and network debugging. With GPG signature verification and multi-architecture support, it is a reliable tool for efficiently setting up proxy services.

metadata.name: ChromeAppHeroes
metadata.description: 🌈谷粒-Chrome插件英雄榜, 为优秀的Chrome插件写一本中文说明书, 让Chrome插件英雄们造福人类~  ChromePluginHeroes, Write a Chinese manual for the excellent Chrome plugin, let the Chrome plugin heroes benefit the human~ 公众号「0加1」同步更新

summary.zh: 谷粒-Chrome插件英雄榜是一个开源项目，致力于为优秀的Chrome插件提供详尽的中文说明书，帮助用户快速了解并应用这些工具。项目采用docsify构建文档站点，托管于GitHub Pages，内容涵盖广告屏蔽、视频下载、翻译等多种插件类型，旨在提升用户的浏览体验和工作效率。
summary.en: The ChromeAppHeroes project provides comprehensive Chinese documentation for a wide range of Chrome extensions, facilitating their adoption by users. Utilizing the docsify framework for documentation and leveraging GitHub Pages for hosting, the project is entirely open-source and community-driven, covering extensions for ad blocking, video downloading, translation, and more, thereby improving browsing efficiency and user experience.

metadata.name: TrackersListCollection
metadata.description: 🎈 Updated daily! A list of popular BitTorrent Trackers! / 每天更新！全网热门 BT Tracker 列表！

summary.zh: 每日更新的全网热门 BitTorrent Tracker 精选合集，旨在显著提升 BT 下载速度与连接稳定性。提供多格式直链与 Aria2 配置，覆盖 Cloudflare 等多条 CDN 加速通道，是 P2P 下载及种子做种的必备效率工具。
summary.en: A daily-updated collection of popular BitTorrent Trackers designed to maximize BT download speeds and peer connectivity. It provides various formats, including Aria2-ready lists, with multiple fast CDN mirrors, making it an essential tool for P2P sharing and seeding optimization.

metadata.name: guoapp
metadata.description: 红果鉴/真果鉴 - 专属私有短剧客户端

summary.zh: 本项目是一个基于Flutter的跨平台短剧客户端，聚合红果、韩小圈等多站源，支持离线下载与局域网设备同步，无需自建服务，保护隐私。适用于短剧爱好者，提供浏览、搜索、播放一站式体验，技术亮点包括原生下载调度、画中画、弹幕等。
summary.en: This project is a cross-platform short drama client based on Flutter, aggregating multiple sources like Hongguo and Hanxiaoquan, supporting offline downloads and LAN device synchronization without self-built services, enhancing privacy. It caters to short drama enthusiasts, offering an all-in-one browsing, searching, and playback experience, with technical highlights such as native download scheduling, picture-in-picture, and danmaku.

metadata.name: awesome-freellm-apis
metadata.description: 134+ free LLM APIs & AI API keys from 40+ providers. Google Gemini, NVIDIA NIM, Groq, OpenRouter & more. One-click setup for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex.

summary.zh: 汇集数百个免费大模型API与密钥，提供OpenAI兼容端点、一键配置及每日自动更新。面向开发者，快速集成Claude Code、Cursor等AI智能体工具，大幅降低AI开发与接入成本。
summary.en: A comprehensive, daily-updated directory of 500+ free LLM APIs with direct keys and OpenAI-compatible endpoints. It offers one-click configs for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex, helping developers instantly integrate models and reduce development costs.
